d: Jharkhand ki rajdhani ranchi ke pithauriya thana kshetr se ek behad dukhad aur sanasnikhej mamla samne aaya hai. jal, jangal, jamin aur aadivasi samaj ke adhikaron ke lie sarak se lekar soshal midiya tak lagatar sangharsh karne vali yuva karyakarta nisha kumari bhagat ne phansi lagakar aatmahatya kar li hai.
